author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 02/12/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, AMZN, RPD, CRNT, FB
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.9%
AAPL: +1.2%
IBM: +1.1%
CSCO: +2.3%
GOOG: +.08%
Technology shares were higher in pre-market trading on Monday.
Expected movers:
- Amazon ( AMZN ): reportedly paid $90 million to buy maker of Blink home security cameras
- Rapid7 ( RPD ): posts wider Q4 loss vs. last year, revenue tops Street
- Ceragon Networks ( CRNT ): adjusted Q4 EPS beats Street view by a penny, revenue well above expectations
Other news:
- Facebook ( FB ), Alphabet ( GOOG ): Unilever (UL, UN) threatens to pull ads from online platforms such as Facebook or Alphabet's YouTube "if they promote hate or create division"
